# Bundled browser dependencies

These pinned upstream distributions are served locally; no CDN fallback or runtime
download is used. Keep licenses beside the files when updating versions.

- Vue 3.5.13 (MIT): `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vue@3.5.13/dist/vue.global.prod.js`
  and `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vue@3.5.13/LICENSE`.
- Brython 3.15.0 (BSD-3-Clause):
  `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/brython@3.15.0/brython.min.js` and
  `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/brython@3.15.0/brython_stdlib.js`.
  License: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brython-dev/brython/3.15.0/LICENCE.txt`.

Files are unmodified upstream distributions, not generated by this project.
